chosen_assumption: Rows are independently sampled people. Treatment t precedes numeric mediator m, which precedes continuous outcome y. All stages are additive and linear, with no treatment-mediator interaction. t may change m, and m may change y; the effect magnitudes are unknown. No hidden factors confound treatment-mediator or mediator-outcome after conditioning on treatment, and no treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounder exists. Treatment is randomized. Treatment may also directly change outcome. No hidden common causes exist. The natural direct and indirect effect magnitudes are unknown. No spillovers or missingness.
